description: Source code for Redis slowlog module, implementing slow query logging, including creation, freeing, initialization, pushing, resetting, and command handling functions.

methods.name: slowlogCreateEntry
methods.description: Creates a new slowlog entry with command details, timestamp, duration, and client info.

methods.name: slowlogFreeEntry
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a slowlog entry, including retained objects and strings.

methods.name: slowlogInit
methods.description: Initializes the slowlog data structure at server startup.

methods.name: slowlogPushEntryIfNeeded
methods.description: Adds a new slowlog entry if the duration exceeds the configured threshold, trimming the log if necessary.

methods.name: slowlogReset
methods.description: Clears all entries from the slowlog.

methods.name: slowlogCommand
methods.description: Handles the SLOWLOG command with subcommands: GET, LEN, RESET, and help.
